variables.name: ECID
variables.description: Experience Cloud ID assigned by AEP Web SDK. Primary cross-session visitor identity.

variables.name: Page URL
variables.description: Full page URL captured on every page view. Baseline dimension for all content analysis.

variables.name: Business Unit
variables.description: Business unit / property identifier. Baseline dimension to segment data across NHB properties.

variables.name: Marketing Channel
variables.description: OOTB Marketing Channel dimension populated via Marketing Channel Processing Rules. Note: processing rules required (not defined here).

variables.name: Campaign Tracking Code
variables.description: Native campaign tracking code sourced from URL query parameter. OOTB s.campaign variable.

variables.name: Campaign Source
variables.description: SAINT Classification of s.campaign — traffic source (utm_source).

variables.name: Environment
variables.description: Environment flag used to isolate production traffic. Drives the 'Production Data Only' segment.

variables.name: Login / Registration Status
variables.description: Registered vs unregistered visitor status. Registration is optional (BRD 203) — unregistered visitors retain full access. Supports 201/202.

variables.name: Hashed Visitor ID
variables.description: [Hashed — PII] SHA-256 hashed visitor/profile ID for AEP & RT-CDP profile management (BRD 204). Hashing occurs in JS before value enters data layer.

variables.name: Consent Tier
variables.description: Three-tier consent state captured at registration (Tier 0 Functional, Tier 1 Festival Marketing, Tier 2 Year-Round NHB). Supports 301/302/304.

variables.name: Cookie Consent Category
variables.description: PDPA cookie-consent categories accepted (Strictly Necessary, Analytics & Performance, Personalisation & Targeting). Supports 1808/1809/1811.

variables.name: Student Cohort Flag
variables.description: Derived student-cohort flag from geolocation cluster, visit timing and referral source. Not stored as permanent PII, refreshed annually (BRD 1806).

variables.name: Page Name
variables.description: Human-readable page name set on every page view. Core content dimension (BRD 101).

variables.name: Site Section
variables.description: Top-level site section for content grouping (Programmes, Trails, Map, Privacy, etc.). Supports 101/107/108.

variables.name: Page Type
variables.description: Template/page type (listing, programme-detail, installation-detail, trail, privacy, terms, cookie-policy). Supports 104/107/108/1812.

variables.name: Festival Edition / Year
variables.description: Festival edition / year context for multi-year comparison. Aligns with firstFestivalYear content field (BRD 1104).

variables.name: Brand Compliance Flag
variables.description: Flag indicating whether a page meets Heritage SG brand guidelines and carries the standard government disclaimer. Supports 106/109.

variables.name: Programme / Installation ID
variables.description: Unique ID of the programme or installation being viewed or interacted with. Underpins QR check-in and listings (BRD 104/601/604).

variables.name: Programme / Installation Title
variables.description: Display title of the programme or installation. Supports listing display tracking (BRD 104).

variables.name: Venue Name
variables.description: Venue associated with a programme/installation. Supports listings, map and crowd-density reporting (BRD 104/401/405).

variables.name: Unlocked Content Status
variables.description: Whether QR-gated unlocked content is present/visible for scanned-in visitors. No empty state when absent (BRD 602/605/1104).

variables.name: Trail Name
variables.description: Name of the curated self-guided trail being viewed, saved or followed. Supports 501/502/507.

variables.name: Itinerary ID
variables.description: Unique ID of a custom or shared itinerary. Supports creation, sharing, login-free viewing and Community Picks (BRD 503/505/506/507).

variables.name: Registration Trigger Moment
variables.description: The moment/context that triggered a registration prompt (QR scan, itinerary adoption, profile). Drives funnel-by-trigger reporting (BRD 603/1205).

variables.name: Consent Action
variables.description: Consent action taken (grant/withdraw) via self-service profile settings; feeds consent log. Supports 302/303/304.

variables.name: Map Interaction Type
variables.description: Type of interaction with the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct MapBox map (pan, zoom, pin-tap, sort). Supports 401/402.

variables.name: Location Permission State
variables.description: Visitor's location-permission state (granted/denied) controlling proximity sorting vs default listing. Supports 403/404.

variables.name: Proximity Zone Label
variables.description: Derived client-side zone label passed to Adobe Target — raw GPS never stored server-side (BRD 1802). Supports proximity sorting (403).

variables.name: QR Scan Context
variables.description: Context of a QR scan (authenticated check-in vs anonymous scan, first vs repeat). Check-in derived from scan events only, not GPS (BRD 601/604/1803).

variables.name: Sharing Method
variables.description: Itinerary sharing method via native device share (no social OAuth). Supports 505/705.

variables.name: Personalisation Use Case
variables.description: Active Adobe Target personalisation use case driving a rendered experience (picks-tonight, trending-circle, returning-banner). Supports 701–706.

variables.name: Brand Concierge Intent
variables.description: Detected visitor intent in a Brand Concierge interaction (programme discovery, trail recommendation, venue info, general). Supports 1405/1406.

variables.name: Brand Concierge Outcome
variables.description: Outcome of a Brand Concierge interaction (answered, escalated, failed). Supports engagement/escalation/failure reporting (BRD 1406).

variables.name: Off-site CTA Destination
variables.description: Destination of off-site call-to-action, primarily the Klook ticketing link. No ticketing on SNF site (BRD 105).

variables.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion
variables.description: Dismissible inline optimisation suggestion surfaced for itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies (BRD 504).

variables.name: Programme Urgency Label
variables.description: Urgency label applied in auto-sorted programme listing (tonight, last-chance post-9pm). Supports 701.

variables.name: Trail Journey Name
variables.description: Journey Name eVar for the trail follow/QR check-in journey. Part of 5-part funnel with Trail Journey Step + start/complete/fail events (BRD 502).

variables.name: Trail Journey Step
variables.description: Journey Step eVar for the trail follow journey (saved, started, checkpoint, completed). Part of 5-part funnel (BRD 502).

variables.name: Registration Journey Name
variables.description: Journey Name eVar for the email-registration + consent journey. Part of 5-part funnel with Registration Journey Step + start/complete/fail events (BRD 201/202/1205).

variables.name: Registration Journey Step
variables.description: Journey Step eVar for the registration journey (email-entered, code-sent, verified, consent-captured). Part of 5-part funnel (BRD 201/202/1205).

variables.name: Internal Search Term
variables.description: On-site / Brand Concierge search keyword used to discover programmes, trails and venues. Supports discovery intents (BRD 1405).

variables.name: Page URL
variables.description: Full page URL of the current page. Mirrors the Page URL eVar for PathFinder/pathing analysis.

variables.name: Business Unit
variables.description: Business unit / brand owning the property. Mirrors the Business Unit eVar for ClickMap/pathing segmentation.

variables.name: Programme / Installation Name
variables.description: Title of the festival programme or installation being viewed. Mirrors the Programme/Installation Name eVar to enable pathing and ClickMap analysis of content navigation.

variables.name: Venue Name
variables.description: Venue associated with the programme / installation. Mirrors the Venue Name eVar for pathing analysis across the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct.

variables.name: Installation ID
variables.description: Unique installation / programme identifier tied to the QR code scanned on check-in. Mirrors the Installation ID eVar to support PathFinder analysis of QR-driven navigation.

variables.name: Trail Name
variables.description: Name of the curated self-guided trail being presented, selected, or followed. Mirrors the Trail Name eVar for pathing across trail selection and navigation.

variables.name: Consent Tier
variables.description: Consent tier captured at registration (Tier 0 Functional, Tier 1 Festival Marketing, Tier 2 Year-Round NHB). Mirrors the Consent Tier eVar for ClickMap analysis of consent interaction. No PII.

variables.name: Registration Trigger Moment
variables.description: The moment / context that triggered the registration prompt (e.g. first QR scan, itinerary adoption, profile save). Mirrors the Registration Trigger Moment eVar to support funnel pathing by trigger.

variables.name: Exit Link / CTA Label
variables.description: Label of the outbound CTA clicked (e.g. Klook ticketing). Mirrors the Exit Link/CTA Label eVar for ClickMap and pathing analysis of off-site redirects.

variables.name: Brand Concierge Intent
variables.description: Classified visitor intent for a Brand Concierge interaction (programme discovery, trail recommendation, venue info, general festival info). Mirrors the Brand Concierge Intent eVar for pathing across conversation flows.

variables.name: Custom Page View
variables.description: Baseline custom page-view counter fired on every page load across all SNF website pages. Supports BRD 101 (instrument Adobe Analytics across all pages) and 103 (responsive delivery across viewports).

variables.name: Registration Start
variables.description: Start event of the email-registration journey — fired when a visitor begins the email registration flow. Start part of the 5-part registration journey/funnel. Supports BRD 201/202 and funnel reporting by trigger moment (BRD 1205).

variables.name: Registration Email Submitted
variables.description: Journey step event — visitor submits email and the one-time code/link is dispatched. Supports mobile-optimised registration flow (BRD 202).

variables.name: Registration Verified (Complete)
variables.description: Complete event of the registration journey — email verified via one-time code or link. Complete part of the 5-part funnel. Supports BRD 201 and registration funnel reporting (BRD 1205).

variables.name: Registration Fail
variables.description: Fail event of the registration journey — verification failed or expired. Fail part of the 5-part funnel for drop-off analysis.

variables.name: Consent Granted
variables.description: Fired when a visitor grants a consent tier (Tier 0 Functional, Tier 1 Festival Marketing, Tier 2 Year-Round NHB). Supports three-tier consent capture (BRD 301/302) and consent tier distribution reporting (BRD 1204). Consent type carried on the associated eVar/consent log.

variables.name: Consent Withdrawn
variables.description: Fired when a visitor withdraws consent via self-service profile settings (effective immediately). Supports BRD 303/304 and consent-log instrumentation.

variables.name: Cookie Consent Submitted
variables.description: Fired when a visitor submits cookie consent choices (Strictly Necessary / Analytics & Performance / Personalisation & Targeting) via the banner or settings control. Supports BRD 1808–1811.

variables.name: Programme/Installation Listing View
variables.description: Fired on display of festival programme and installation listings (title, description, venue, dates, times). Supports BRD 104.

variables.name: Programme Detail View
variables.description: Fired on view of a programme/installation detail page. Supports BRD 104 and detail-page engagement reporting.

variables.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Click
variables.description: Fired when a visitor clicks the Klook ticketing call-to-action directing off-site. No ticketing is built on the SNF website. Supports BRD 105 (off-site CTA exit tracking).

variables.name: Bookmark Add
variables.description: Fired when a visitor bookmarks a programme/installation. Feeds the 'Your picks tonight' affinity feed (BRD 702) and 'Trending with your circle' chip clustering (BRD 703).

variables.name: Map Interaction
variables.description: Fired on interaction with the interactive Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (pan, zoom, pin tap). Supports BRD 401/402 (MapBox map) and map interaction dashboard (BRD 1201).

variables.name: Location Permission Granted
variables.description: Fired when a visitor grants location permission, enabling proximity-based sorting of map and listings by walking distance. Geolocation processed client-side only; derived zone label passed to Adobe Target (BRD 1802). Supports BRD 403.

variables.name: Location Permission Denied
variables.description: Fired when a visitor denies location permission; listings fall back to default behaviour without degradation. Supports BRD 404.

variables.name: Venue Crowd Indicator View
variables.description: Fired when a live per-venue crowd density indicator is displayed. Indicators derived from real-time Adobe Analytics session data. Supports BRD 405/406.

variables.name: Trail View
variables.description: Fired on presentation/view of a curated self-guided trail for selection and navigation. Supports BRD 501.

variables.name: Trail Saved
variables.description: Fired when a registered visitor saves/follows a trail (progress tracked via QR check-ins). Supports BRD 502.

variables.name: Itinerary Created
variables.description: Fired when a visitor creates a custom itinerary. Supports BRD 503.

variables.name: Itinerary Item Added
variables.description: Fired when a visitor adds a chosen programme/installation to a custom itinerary. Supports BRD 503.

variables.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion Shown
variables.description: Fired when a dismissible, non-blocking inline optimisation suggestion is surfaced on detection of itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies. Supports BRD 504.

variables.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion Dismissed
variables.description: Fired when a visitor dismisses an inline optimisation suggestion. Supports BRD 504 (dismissible, non-blocking).

variables.name: Itinerary Shared
variables.description: Fired when a visitor shares an itinerary via native device share (no social platform OAuth). Supports BRD 505/705.

variables.name: Shared Itinerary Viewed (No Auth)
variables.description: Fired when a shared itinerary is viewed without authentication. Supports BRD 506.

variables.name: Itinerary One-Tap Adoption
variables.description: Fired on one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary, triggering a light registration prompt. Counts toward the ≥10 unique festival-window adoptions threshold for Community Picks. Supports BRD 506/507/705.

variables.name: Community Pick Surfaced
variables.description: Fired when an itinerary with ≥10 unique festival-window adoptions is surfaced as a Community Pick on the Trails page. Supports BRD 507/705.

variables.name: QR Scan
variables.description: Fired when a visitor scans an installation/programme QR code, loading the detail page including unlocked content visible only to physically scanned-in visitors. First scan by an unauthenticated visitor triggers a dismissible registration prompt (BRD 603). Supports BRD 601/602.

variables.name: QR Check-in Confirmed
variables.description: Fired when a QR scan is recorded against a registered visitor's profile as a confirmed check-in, capturing installation ID and timestamp. Check-in data derived exclusively from QR scan events, not GPS (BRD 1803). Supports BRD 604 and QR rate dashboard (BRD 1201).

metrics_segments.name: Production Data Only
metrics_segments.description: Restricts reporting to production environment hits where Environment eVar = 'production'. Mandatory baseline segment on every SDR.

metrics_segments.name: All Visits
metrics_segments.description: Baseline segment capturing all qualifying visits in the report suite.

metrics_segments.name: New Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Baseline segment isolating first-time visitors (OOTB new/return visitor dimension).

metrics_segments.name: Returning Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Baseline segment isolating returning visitors (OOTB new/return visitor dimension).

metrics_segments.name: Registered Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who have completed email registration (Login Status eVar = 'registered'). Supports BRD 201/202 registration measurement.

metrics_segments.name: Unregistered Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitors with no completed registration (Login Status eVar = 'unregistered'). Confirms optional-registration full-access behaviour.

metrics_segments.name: Student Cohort (Derived)
metrics_segments.description: Visitors flagged as student cohort via derived geolocation/visit-timing/referral signal. No permanent PII stored; refreshed annually.

metrics_segments.name: Tier 1 Consent — Festival Marketing
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who positively granted Tier 1 (Festival Marketing) consent at registration.

metrics_segments.name: Tier 2 Consent — Year-Round NHB
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who positively granted Tier 2 (Year-Round NHB) consent at registration.

metrics_segments.name: Consent Withdrawn
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who withdrew consent via self-service profile settings. Supports consent withdrawal measurement.

metrics_segments.name: Analytics Cookie Consent Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who granted Analytics & Performance cookie consent category.

metrics_segments.name: Personalisation Cookie Consent Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who granted Personalisation & Targeting cookie consent category.

metrics_segments.name: QR Check-in Visitors
metrics_segments.description: Visitors with one or more confirmed QR check-in events recorded against their profile.

metrics_segments.name: Unlocked Content Viewers
metrics_segments.description: Visits that viewed QR-unlocked content visible only to physically scanned-in visitors.

metrics_segments.name: Klook Ticketing Clickers
metrics_segments.description: Visits with a Klook ticketing CTA click directing off-site.

metrics_segments.name: Map Interaction Visits
metrics_segments.description: Visits that interacted with the interactive Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map.

metrics_segments.name: Location Permission Granted
metrics_segments.description: Visits where the visitor granted location permission enabling proximity-based sorting.

metrics_segments.name: Brand Concierge Engagers
metrics_segments.description: Visits that engaged with the Adobe Brand Concierge assistant.

metrics_segments.name: Trail Followers
metrics_segments.description: Registered visitors who saved and followed a self-guided trail with QR progress tracking.

metrics_segments.name: Itinerary Creators
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who created a custom itinerary by adding programmes/installations.

metrics_segments.name: Itinerary Sharers
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who shared an itinerary via native device share.

metrics_segments.name: Shared Itinerary Adopters
metrics_segments.description: Visitors who one-tap adopted a shared itinerary, triggering a light registration prompt.

metrics_segments.name: Registration Funnel — Started
metrics_segments.description: Visits that started the email registration flow (funnel start event fired).

metrics_segments.name: Registration Funnel — Completed
metrics_segments.description: Visits that completed email registration verified via one-time code/link (funnel complete event fired).

metrics_segments.name: Registration Funnel — Abandoned
metrics_segments.description: Visits that started but did not complete registration (start without complete).

metrics_segments.name: QR-Triggered Registration Prompts
metrics_segments.description: Visits where a dismissible registration prompt fired on first QR scan by an unauthenticated visitor.

metrics_segments.name: Bounce Rate
metrics_segments.description: Baseline calculated metric: single-hit visits as a proportion of total visits.

metrics_segments.name: Conversion Rate
metrics_segments.description: Baseline calculated metric: key conversion events (e.g. registration completions) divided by visits.

metrics_segments.name: Pages per Visit
metrics_segments.description: Baseline calculated metric: total page views divided by visits.

metrics_segments.name: QR Check-in Rate
metrics_segments.description: Calculated metric: QR check-in events divided by visits, supporting the QR rates reporting dashboard.

metrics_segments.name: Registration Completion Rate
metrics_segments.description: Calculated metric: registration completions divided by registration starts, supporting the registration funnel dashboard.

metrics_segments.name: Average Page Load Time
metrics_segments.description: Calculated metric: Page Load Time (ms) Numeric event divided by Page Load Time Instances Counter event.

props.label: Section A — OOTB / Standard Props (Adobe Consulting Locked Catalog)

props.name: Page URL
props.description: Full page URL of the current page. Mirrors the Page URL eVar for PathFinder/pathing analysis.

props.name: Business Unit
props.description: Business unit / brand owning the property. Mirrors the Business Unit eVar for ClickMap/pathing segmentation.

props.label: Section B — Custom Props (mirror Section B eVars; PathFinder / PatternMatch / ClickMap use only)

props.name: Programme / Installation Name
props.description: Title of the festival programme or installation being viewed. Mirrors the Programme/Installation Name eVar to enable pathing and ClickMap analysis of content navigation.

props.name: Venue Name
props.description: Venue associated with the programme / installation. Mirrors the Venue Name eVar for pathing analysis across the Bras Basah–Bugis precinct.

props.name: Installation ID
props.description: Unique installation / programme identifier tied to the QR code scanned on check-in. Mirrors the Installation ID eVar to support PathFinder analysis of QR-driven navigation.

props.name: Trail Name
props.description: Name of the curated self-guided trail being presented, selected, or followed. Mirrors the Trail Name eVar for pathing across trail selection and navigation.

props.name: Consent Tier
props.description: Consent tier captured at registration (Tier 0 Functional, Tier 1 Festival Marketing, Tier 2 Year-Round NHB). Mirrors the Consent Tier eVar for ClickMap analysis of consent interaction. No PII.

props.name: Registration Trigger Moment
props.description: The moment / context that triggered the registration prompt (e.g. first QR scan, itinerary adoption, profile save). Mirrors the Registration Trigger Moment eVar to support funnel pathing by trigger.

props.name: Exit Link / CTA Label
props.description: Label of the outbound CTA clicked (e.g. Klook ticketing). Mirrors the Exit Link/CTA Label eVar for ClickMap and pathing analysis of off-site redirects.

props.name: Brand Concierge Intent
props.description: Classified visitor intent for a Brand Concierge interaction (programme discovery, trail recommendation, venue info, general festival info). Mirrors the Brand Concierge Intent eVar for pathing across conversation flows.

events.label: Section A — OOTB / Standard Events (AEP Web SDK)

events.name: Custom Page View
events.description: Baseline custom page-view counter fired on every page load across all SNF website pages. Supports BRD 101 (instrument Adobe Analytics across all pages) and 103 (responsive delivery across viewports).

events.name: Page Load Time (ms)
events.description: Baseline page load time in milliseconds. Numeric half of the mandatory Page Load Time pair; combine with instances counter for Avg Page Load Time calculated metric. Supports Core Web Vitals tracking (BRD 1504).

events.name: Page Load Time Instances
events.description: Baseline page load time instances counter. Counter half of the mandatory Page Load Time pair; denominator for Avg Page Load Time calculated metric.

events.name: Registration Start
events.description: Start event of the email-registration journey — fired when a visitor begins the email registration flow. Start part of the 5-part registration journey/funnel. Supports BRD 201/202 and funnel reporting by trigger moment (BRD 1205).

events.name: Registration Email Submitted
events.description: Journey step event — visitor submits email and the one-time code/link is dispatched. Supports mobile-optimised registration flow (BRD 202).

events.name: Registration Verified (Complete)
events.description: Complete event of the registration journey — email verified via one-time code or link. Complete part of the 5-part funnel. Supports BRD 201 and registration funnel reporting (BRD 1205).

events.name: Registration Fail
events.description: Fail event of the registration journey — verification failed or expired. Fail part of the 5-part funnel for drop-off analysis.

events.name: Consent Granted
events.description: Fired when a visitor grants a consent tier (Tier 0 Functional, Tier 1 Festival Marketing, Tier 2 Year-Round NHB). Supports three-tier consent capture (BRD 301/302) and consent tier distribution reporting (BRD 1204). Consent type carried on the associated eVar/consent log.

events.name: Consent Withdrawn
events.description: Fired when a visitor withdraws consent via self-service profile settings (effective immediately). Supports BRD 303/304 and consent-log instrumentation.

events.name: Cookie Consent Submitted
events.description: Fired when a visitor submits cookie consent choices (Strictly Necessary / Analytics & Performance / Personalisation & Targeting) via the banner or settings control. Supports BRD 1808–1811.

events.name: Programme/Installation Listing View
events.description: Fired on display of festival programme and installation listings (title, description, venue, dates, times). Supports BRD 104.

events.name: Programme Detail View
events.description: Fired on view of a programme/installation detail page. Supports BRD 104 and detail-page engagement reporting.

events.name: Klook Ticketing CTA Click
events.description: Fired when a visitor clicks the Klook ticketing call-to-action directing off-site. No ticketing is built on the SNF website. Supports BRD 105 (off-site CTA exit tracking).

events.name: Bookmark Add
events.description: Fired when a visitor bookmarks a programme/installation. Feeds the 'Your picks tonight' affinity feed (BRD 702) and 'Trending with your circle' chip clustering (BRD 703).

events.name: Map Interaction
events.description: Fired on interaction with the interactive Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map (pan, zoom, pin tap). Supports BRD 401/402 (MapBox map) and map interaction dashboard (BRD 1201).

events.name: Location Permission Granted
events.description: Fired when a visitor grants location permission, enabling proximity-based sorting of map and listings by walking distance. Geolocation processed client-side only; derived zone label passed to Adobe Target (BRD 1802). Supports BRD 403.

events.name: Location Permission Denied
events.description: Fired when a visitor denies location permission; listings fall back to default behaviour without degradation. Supports BRD 404.

events.name: Venue Crowd Indicator View
events.description: Fired when a live per-venue crowd density indicator is displayed. Indicators derived from real-time Adobe Analytics session data. Supports BRD 405/406.

events.name: Trail View
events.description: Fired on presentation/view of a curated self-guided trail for selection and navigation. Supports BRD 501.

events.name: Trail Saved
events.description: Fired when a registered visitor saves/follows a trail (progress tracked via QR check-ins). Supports BRD 502.

events.name: Itinerary Created
events.description: Fired when a visitor creates a custom itinerary. Supports BRD 503.

events.name: Itinerary Item Added
events.description: Fired when a visitor adds a chosen programme/installation to a custom itinerary. Supports BRD 503.

events.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion Shown
events.description: Fired when a dismissible, non-blocking inline optimisation suggestion is surfaced on detection of itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies. Supports BRD 504.

events.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion Dismissed
events.description: Fired when a visitor dismisses an inline optimisation suggestion. Supports BRD 504 (dismissible, non-blocking).

events.name: Itinerary Shared
events.description: Fired when a visitor shares an itinerary via native device share (no social platform OAuth). Supports BRD 505/705.

events.name: Shared Itinerary Viewed (No Auth)
events.description: Fired when a shared itinerary is viewed without authentication. Supports BRD 506.

events.name: Itinerary One-Tap Adoption
events.description: Fired on one-tap adoption of a shared itinerary, triggering a light registration prompt. Counts toward the ≥10 unique festival-window adoptions threshold for Community Picks. Supports BRD 506/507/705.

events.name: Community Pick Surfaced
events.description: Fired when an itinerary with ≥10 unique festival-window adoptions is surfaced as a Community Pick on the Trails page. Supports BRD 507/705.

events.name: QR Scan
events.description: Fired when a visitor scans an installation/programme QR code, loading the detail page including unlocked content visible only to physically scanned-in visitors. First scan by an unauthenticated visitor triggers a dismissible registration prompt (BRD 603). Supports BRD 601/602.

events.name: QR Check-in Confirmed
events.description: Fired when a QR scan is recorded against a registered visitor's profile as a confirmed check-in, capturing installation ID and timestamp. Check-in data derived exclusively from QR scan events, not GPS (BRD 1803). Supports BRD 604 and QR rate dashboard (BRD 1201).

segments.name: Production Data Only
segments.description: Restricts reporting to production environment hits where Environment eVar = 'production'. Mandatory baseline segment on every SDR.

segments.name: All Visits
segments.description: Baseline segment capturing all qualifying visits in the report suite.

segments.name: New Visitors
segments.description: Baseline segment isolating first-time visitors (OOTB new/return visitor dimension).

segments.name: Returning Visitors
segments.description: Baseline segment isolating returning visitors (OOTB new/return visitor dimension).

segments.name: Registered Visitors
segments.description: Visitors who have completed email registration (Login Status eVar = 'registered'). Supports BRD 201/202 registration measurement.

segments.name: Unregistered Visitors
segments.description: Visitors with no completed registration (Login Status eVar = 'unregistered'). Confirms optional-registration full-access behaviour.

segments.name: Student Cohort (Derived)
segments.description: Visitors flagged as student cohort via derived geolocation/visit-timing/referral signal. No permanent PII stored; refreshed annually.

segments.name: Tier 1 Consent — Festival Marketing
segments.description: Visitors who positively granted Tier 1 (Festival Marketing) consent at registration.

segments.name: Tier 2 Consent — Year-Round NHB
segments.description: Visitors who positively granted Tier 2 (Year-Round NHB) consent at registration.

segments.name: Consent Withdrawn
segments.description: Visitors who withdrew consent via self-service profile settings. Supports consent withdrawal measurement.

segments.name: Analytics Cookie Consent Granted
segments.description: Visitors who granted Analytics & Performance cookie consent category.

segments.name: Personalisation Cookie Consent Granted
segments.description: Visitors who granted Personalisation & Targeting cookie consent category.

segments.name: QR Check-in Visitors
segments.description: Visitors with one or more confirmed QR check-in events recorded against their profile.

segments.name: Unlocked Content Viewers
segments.description: Visits that viewed QR-unlocked content visible only to physically scanned-in visitors.

segments.name: Klook Ticketing Clickers
segments.description: Visits with a Klook ticketing CTA click directing off-site.

segments.name: Map Interaction Visits
segments.description: Visits that interacted with the interactive Bras Basah–Bugis precinct map.

segments.name: Location Permission Granted
segments.description: Visits where the visitor granted location permission enabling proximity-based sorting.

segments.name: Brand Concierge Engagers
segments.description: Visits that engaged with the Adobe Brand Concierge assistant.

segments.name: Trail Followers
segments.description: Registered visitors who saved and followed a self-guided trail with QR progress tracking.

segments.name: Itinerary Creators
segments.description: Visitors who created a custom itinerary by adding programmes/installations.

segments.name: Itinerary Sharers
segments.description: Visitors who shared an itinerary via native device share.

segments.name: Shared Itinerary Adopters
segments.description: Visitors who one-tap adopted a shared itinerary, triggering a light registration prompt.

segments.name: Registration Funnel — Started
segments.description: Visits that started the email registration flow (funnel start event fired).

segments.name: Registration Funnel — Completed
segments.description: Visits that completed email registration verified via one-time code/link (funnel complete event fired).

segments.name: Registration Funnel — Abandoned
segments.description: Visits that started but did not complete registration (start without complete).

segments.name: QR-Triggered Registration Prompts
segments.description: Visits where a dismissible registration prompt fired on first QR scan by an unauthenticated visitor.

segments.name: Bounce Rate
segments.description: Baseline calculated metric: single-hit visits as a proportion of total visits.

segments.name: Conversion Rate
segments.description: Baseline calculated metric: key conversion events (e.g. registration completions) divided by visits.

segments.name: Pages per Visit
segments.description: Baseline calculated metric: total page views divided by visits.

segments.name: QR Check-in Rate
segments.description: Calculated metric: QR check-in events divided by visits, supporting the QR rates reporting dashboard.

segments.name: Registration Completion Rate
segments.description: Calculated metric: registration completions divided by registration starts, supporting the registration funnel dashboard.

segments.name: Average Page Load Time
segments.description: Calculated metric: Page Load Time (ms) Numeric event divided by Page Load Time Instances Counter event.
